mapper.sql: select cr.id, cr.student_id, cr.subject_id, cr.teacher_id, cr.cancel_hours, cr.cancel_time, cr.photo_url, cr.remark, s.student_name, sub.subject_name, t.teacher_name from edu_cancellation_record cr left join edu_student s on cr.student_id = s.id left join edu_subject sub on cr.subject_id = sub.id left join edu_teacher t on cr.teacher_id = t.id
mapper.insert: insert into edu_cancellation_record (student_id, subject_id, teacher_id, cancel_hours, cancel_time, photo_url, remark, create_time) values(#{studentId}, #{subjectId}, #{teacherId}, #{cancelHours}, #{cancelTime}, #{photoUrl}, #{remark}, sysdate())
